## Overview

This version marks the beginning of consistent semantic versioning for `llama.cpp`. The main goal is to make the job of downstream projects and users simpler when deciding which version of `llama.cpp`/`ggml` to distribute and use. The new version tags of the format `vX.Y.Z` will mark "stable" versions of `llama.cpp`. The usual `b[NUM]` tags remain as before - created on almost every commit to the `master` branch.
